4279-5687-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2595-4050-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4050-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4050-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

654-5531-5694-5913-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-5531-5694-5913-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-5531-5694-5913-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Pinnacle Monk and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2577-5147-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5147-5478-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5147-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2073-4779-7877-7878.description:

When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

338-475-5641-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-475-5641-7810.description:

Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.

392-3292-3892-7297.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.

When Yavimaya Elder enters, Tireless Provisioner and Zimone trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.

Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

250-779-1479-5414-6754.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-6754.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.

Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.

Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4153-6575-7060--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-7060--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.

Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.

323-6215.description:
At the beginning of each upkeep, Tombostone Stairwell's first ability triggers, causing each player to create a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature card in their graveyard.

2034-2527-4275-5489-5490.notablePrerequisites:

2034-2527-4275-5489-5490.description:
Activate Zellix by paying {1} and tapping it.
Haunted One triggers, causing all Horrors you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Zellix ability, causing a player to mill three cards.
If the player milled a creature card this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {C}{C}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Horrors.

Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {B/G}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.

Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Golgari Rot Farm.

259-933-2104.description:

Move to your next durn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.

Move to your next turn.

1-1633-2060-4120-4772.description:

Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Containment Construct triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
If you discarded Hanabi Blast, cast it from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Otherwise, cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

721-2724-4405.notablePrerequisites: Coastal Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-4405.description:

Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Coastal Wizard by tapping it, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coastal Wizard by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2608-3664.notablePrerequisites: {1} plus three additional mana in at least two colors among {W}, {U}, or
2034-2608-3664.description:

Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to put Derevi into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.
